raw_universe_theorem.statement: For every ordinary pivot in a unit-free state with n>=2 live variables, RAW_x <= Uraw(n)=3^(n-2)*(2n+1).
raw_universe_theorem.proof_summary: Frozen eliminate_var_capped charges each distinct retained/non-tautological resolvent clause at most once. After eliminating one pivot, charged clauses lie in the finite universe of consistent nonempty signed clauses on n-1 variables. Summing their state-unit costs gives Uraw(n).

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N24
theorem.statement: For every legitimate root with frozen input size N<=24, whenever the current frozen solver reaches an ordinary-elimination stage instead of terminating earlier, every required ordinary step remains available under the original N^2 raw cap until the exact <=2-variable terminal lane. Thus v2/v3 cannot be required due to raw-cap unavailability on these size layers.
